jobs.prompt:
Run this exact command in the terminal and return its full stdout as the final response:

{{HERMES_HOME_PARENT}}/.workbuddy/binaries/python/envs/ate/Scripts/python.exe {{JINCE_ENGINE}}/event_news_feed.py

Rules:
- If the command succeeds (exit 0), the final response is just the stdout lines verbatim.
- If it fails or times out, the final response must be a short alert: "[event_news_feed FAIL] <error summary>. feed 抓取失败, event_guard 走 fail-open 沿用上一份定级, 交易不阻塞; 请人工检查 {{JINCE_ENGINE}}/data/event_news_feed.json 的 errors 字段。"
- Do NOT modify any files, do NOT schedule other jobs, do NOT call any other tool. Single script run, report stdout.
